description: Turns the check you ran against the rules from get_compliance_rules into a scorecard: findings by severity, the ISO 27001 controls and DPDP Act sections affected, and the fix for each. Report a clean check too. Regulane does not store it. Send no source code, secrets or personal data.

agent.description: Which coding agent you are, such as "Claude Code", "Cursor", "GitHub Copilot", "Codex".

commit.description: Commit SHA the check ran against, if known.

findings.description: One entry per problem found. Empty when the check is clean.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root.

line.description: Line number, if there is one.

rule_id.description: The rule broken, such as RG-SC-004.

summary.description: One sentence on the problem. No code, secrets or personal data.

repository.description: The git remote URL, or the project folder name when there is no remote.

rules_checked.description: Every rule id you checked, including those with no finding.

scope.description: One line on what was examined, such as "staged changes, 6 files" or "src/payments".

name: report_compliance_check
title: Get a Regulane compliance scorecard
